question: Explain the main causes of the First World War. Address political, military, and economic factors, and support your answer with evidence.

criteria.description: Identifies political causes (e.g. alliance systems, nationalism, the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand as a trigger).
Identifies military causes (e.g. arms race, militarism, mobilization plans such as the Schlieffen Plan).
Identifies economic causes (e.g. imperial/colonial competition, industrial and trade rivalry between powers).
Supports claims with specific, accurate historical evidence rather than unsupported assertion.
